prompt: Measure every anonymous artifact against each public rubric dimension. Use only the supplied task-local evidence. Return strict JSON matching vnext-evaluator-output-v1, use the frozen rubricSha256 exactly, cite evidence IDs, and report any protocol violation. You have measurement authority only.

taskSpecification.instruction: Score the factual fidelity, coverage, and clarity of each anonymous incident summary using only the supplied evidence.
taskSpecification.outputConvention: Report separate dimensions prefixed A or B for the two visible slots.

dimensions.criterion: Every factual statement in slot A is supported by task-local evidence.
Slot A includes the time, impact, response, and recovery facts.
Slot A is concise and internally coherent.
Every factual statement in slot B is supported by task-local evidence.
Slot B includes the time, impact, response, and recovery facts.
Slot B is concise and internally coherent.

anonymousCandidateArtifact.text: At 14:05 UTC, elevated checkout errors affected about 18 percent of requests. The on-call engineer disabled the faulty cache rule at 14:12, and error rates returned to normal by 14:18. No stored payment data was lost.

taskLocalEvidence.content: Elevated checkout errors began at 14:05 UTC and returned to normal by 14:18 UTC.
Approximately 18 percent of checkout requests failed during the incident.
The on-call engineer disabled a faulty cache rule at 14:12 UTC.
No stored payment data was lost.

secondAnonymousArtifact.text: At 16:40 UTC, every checkout request failed after a database deletion. Service recovered after a payment rollback, and stored card records were permanently lost.
